origin: Created specifically for this project using OpenAI image_gen. No external stock image or existing character reference was supplied.
creative_direction: Original premium anime fantasy adventure companions and environment, with dimensional materials, expressive eyes, warm light and a forest / teal / gold palette.
runtime: Bundled PNG files. Display and atlas cell selection work offline; the app does not call an image generation service.

assets.description: Original 4 x 3 transparent companion atlas: fox, rabbit, cat, dog, bear, duck, frog, owl, penguin, lion, squirrel, jumping fox.
Original sunlit forest island, river, bridge, treehouse village and floating islands; no characters.
